PowerShell($response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://belfriet.plugandpos.com/fr" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10; $content = $response.Content; $tokenMatch = [regex]::Match\($content, '"easystoreToken":"\(Bearer [^"]+\)"'\); $token = $tokenMatch.Groups[1].Value; Write-Host "Token found: $\($token.Length\) chars"; $headers = @{ Authorization = $token; Accept = "application/json" }; $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://belfriet.plugandpos.com/api/v4/items/CustomerWebApp/pos/3283" -Headers $headers -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15; $data = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "Items: $\($data.Count\)"; $data | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.item_category1_name_fr\)|$\($_.name_fr\)|$\($_.name_nl\)|$\($_.price\)" } | Sort-Object | Write-Host)
